## Usage

```text
provenance verify <command>
```

Verify binary artifacts and repository content hashes.

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`verify artifact`]({{< relref "verify-artifact.md" >}}) | Check a binary against the published release manifest |
| [`verify content`]({{< relref "verify-content.md" >}}) | Compute the whole-repository content hash |
